summary: Studio Art Engine: an NFT collection generator focused on layer-based creation, rarity/rules, preview, and export; expanding multi-chain metadata export with Ethereum (ERC-721) as the default format.
architectural_notes: Blockchain selector should include Ethereum/Polygon/Base/BNB (export-only) and default new projects to Ethereum (ERC-721).
Users can change the target chain later during metadata generation/export (default is not locked-in).
Cardano (CIP-25) and Tezos (FA2) options/support should be removed.
known_issues: Pinata IPFS directory upload fails with HTTP 400: {"error":"More than one file and/or directory was provided for pinning."}

existing_features.title: Fix the Pinata directory upload implementation so uploading a full generated collection (all images + metadata) no longer fails with the error "Directory upload failed: 400" around 50% progress.

Update the Pinata directory upload request payload to follow Pinata's expected format for directory wrapping (e.g., include directory paths for files and include required Pinata options to wrap files as a directory), while keeping the existing API endpoint and JWT Bearer auth approach.

Improve error reporting for failed Pinata uploads by capturing and surfacing the response body/text (when available) alongside the HTTP status code so that future failures are diagnosable from the UI toast/status message.

Update the Pinata directory upload implementation so uploading a generated collection to Pinata no longer fails with HTTP 400: {"error":"More than one file and/or directory was provided for pinning."}. This includes adjusting the multipart/form-data payload sent to https://api.pinata.cloud/pinning/pinFileToIPFS to match Pinata’s directory upload expectations when multiple files are provided (and the request must still use JWT Bearer auth).

Ensure the image URI paths in generated metadata remain correct after the directory-upload payload change (e.g., if files are uploaded under a directory prefix/path, metadata must reference ipfs://<imageDirCID>/<correct relative path>).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add full export-only metadata support for Polygon (ERC-721), Base (ERC-721), and BNB Chain (BEP-721)
Change default new collection chain/metadata format from Solana (Metaplex) to Ethereum (ERC-721); allow users to switch chain later during metadata generation
Remove Cardano (CIP-25) and Tezos (FA2) chain options/support from export selector
Planned: Full ICP-native storage of NFTs (images + metadata + assets stored in canister storage)
Planned: Project-level cloud sync so artwork/collections persist across sessions
Planned: Advanced rarity analytics and collection-grade statistical reports
